description: This file is a FastAPI route definitions module for an e-commerce backend, implementing endpoints for health check, authentication, store and product listing, cart management, and order processing.

classes.name: ApiMessage
classes.description: Schema for simple API message responses.

classes.name: CartItemOut
classes.description: Schema for individual cart item details.

classes.name: CartAddItemRequest
classes.description: Schema for adding items to cart.

classes.name: CartUpdateItemRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating cart item quantity.

methods.name: CartOut _calc_cart(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Calculates the current cart's items and subtotal for a user.

methods.name: ApiMessage health()
methods.description: Health check endpoint indicating service status.

methods.name: TokenResponse register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user and return a JWT token.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: User authentication endpoint returning a JWT token.

methods.name: UserOut me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches the current authenticated user's profile.

methods.name: list[StoreOut] list_stores( q: Optional[str] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Lists all active stores, optionally filtered by query.

methods.name: StoreOut get_store(store_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific store by its ID.

methods.name: list[ProductOut] list_products( store_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None, q: Optional[str] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Lists available products, optionally filtered by store and search query.

methods.name: ProductOut get_product(product_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific product by its ID.

methods.name: CartOut get_cart(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's cart details.

methods.name: CartOut add_cart_item( payload: CartAddItemRequest, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Adds a product to the user's cart or increases quantity if already present.

methods.name: CartOut update_cart_item( cart_item_id: uuid.UUID, payload: CartUpdateItemRequest, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Updates the quantity of an existing cart item or removes it if quantity is zero.

methods.name: OrderOut create_order_from_cart( user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates an order from the current user's cart, then clears the cart.

methods.name: list[OrderOut] list_orders( user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Lists orders for the user based on their role (user, vendor, admin).

methods.name: OrderOut get_order( order_id: uuid.UUID, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific order with access control.
